summary: 10-Q for Q1 2026 (ended March 31, 2026) shows 327,009,578 Class A and 732,224,903 Class B shares outstanding at quarter-end (1,059,234,481 total), with 330,788,302 Class A as of May 4, 2026; ABTC raised ~$110.5M net via ATM offering in Q1 2026 issuing 84M+ Class A shares; no convertible debt or preferred stock outstanding.

American Bitcoin Corp. effected a 1-for-15 reverse stock split of its Class A common stock, effective July 2, 2026, with trading on a split-adjusted basis beginning July 6, 2026. No BTC holdings, debt, or other capital structure details were disclosed in this filing.
